title: FNA ABAWD waiver document extraction
description: Canonical extraction schema for a single FNA ABAWD time-limit waiver document (application, FNS/FNA response, or combined). Nested: request_level (document-wide fields) + groups[] (geographic bundles) each holding geographic_units[]. Flattened downstream to one panel row per (document x group x geographic unit) to align with the ND/WI hand-collected gold standard. Provenance (document_id, paths, run_id, extractor) is attached by the driver, NOT emitted by the model. v1_1 adds: per-unit orig_text / non_standard_geography / balance_of_county; per-group soft_criterion_invoked and data_nonconformance; request-level possible_double_counting.

document_type.description: Classification of what this PDF is. 'fns_response_only' = an FNS/FNA decision letter or Waiver Response form with no state application attached. 'state_request_only' = the state's request with no FNS action. 'full_application' = state request AND FNS response bundled. 'other_nonstandard' = anything else (cover memo, map, data spreadsheet only).

non_conforming_document.description: true if this document carries no usable ABAWD waiver decision/request content.

non_conforming_reason.description: < 50 words, only when non_conforming_document = true, else null.

waiver_serial_number.description: FNS Waiver Serial Number (near the top and in field 1 of the Waiver Response). String for one; array of strings if several serials appear in one document. null if absent.

type_of_request.description: 'Type of Request' verbatim: e.g. 'Initial', 'Extension', 'Modification', 'Extension and Modification'.

state.description: State/jurisdiction name exactly as shown on the form.

action_reason_approval_denial.description: 'Action and reason for approval or denial' - whether FNS approved/denied and why. Near-verbatim.

reg_leg_action_basis.description: 'Regulatory or legislative basis for action' - the legal authority FNS cites.

expiration_date.description: 'Expiration date'. YYYY-MM-DD if determinable, else the verbatim text, else null.

limits_on_regional_office_approvals.description: 'Limitation, if any, on regional office approval of like requests'.

alt_procedures_desc.description: 'Description of proposed alternative procedures'. Often long; if it contains tables/lists, encode as a valid escaped markdown string. null if absent.

date_national_office_action.description: 'Date of national office action'. YYYY-MM-DD if determinable, else null.

date_state_request.description: 'Date of State agency request'. YYYY-MM-DD or null.

date_ro_transmittal_request.description: 'Date of regional office transmittal of request'. YYYY-MM-DD or null.

date_ro_transmittal_response.description: 'Date of regional office transmittal of response to State agency'. YYYY-MM-DD or null.

response_date.description: Date on the FNS letter/date line. YYYY-MM-DD or null.

number_of_groups.description: Count of geographic bundles in groups[] (0 if none / non-conforming).

possible_double_counting.description: true if a single geographic unit appears in MORE THAN ONE group in this request (a unit assigned to multiple waived groups; banned since the 2006 guidance). Include near-duplicates: a county and its own 'balance of' remainder, or spelling variants of the same place. false if every unit is unique across groups; null for non-conforming / zero- or single-group documents where the check is moot.

double_counting_note.description: The unit(s) involved and the groups they span. null unless possible_double_counting = true.

notes.description: Free-text observations about the request that belong to no group — most often an area the document mentions as eligible or designated that the state did NOT request. Do not create a group for such an area; record it here.

groups.description: One entry per geographic bundle evaluated under a common action/rationale. A bundle may hold one or many geographic units. If different units in the same request are approved under different rules or with different actions, split them into separate groups.

orig_text.description: The unit EXACTLY as printed, including the trailing type word and any spelling/typo (of the form '<Name> city', 'Balance of <Name> County', '<Name> Reservation'). Ground-truth anchor for deterministic downstream parsing; never omit.

name.description: Core place name with the trailing type word removed (the '<Name>' part). Preserve original spelling, including apparent typos, unless it is within a character or two of exactly one name in the state geography reference.

area_type.description: Unit type if stated/inferable: county, city, parish, borough, census area, reservation area, LMA/labor market area, independent city, planning region, town, balance of county, statewide, national. else null.

non_standard_geography.description: true if the unit has NO clean single BLS/LAUS published series: tribal reservation, sub-city neighborhood/ward, ZIP code, school district, census tract, non-New-England place under 25,000, or a custom/partial-area carve-out. false for standard LAUS units (states/DC/PR; MSAs, metropolitan divisions, micropolitan areas, combined statistical areas, and pre-2025 New England NECTAs; small labor market areas; counties and county-equivalents; cities >=25,000; all New England cities/towns; balance-of-county/state series). See the prompt for the full standard set and the pre-2025 NECTA rule. Default false; null only when the unit text is too illegible to classify.

non_standard_geography_note.description: Short reason when non_standard_geography = true (e.g. 'Navajo Nation reservation', 'portion of city'); else null.

balance_of_county.description: true if the unit is the 'balance of' a county — the county minus its separately-listed cities/towns ('Balance of X County', 'remainder of X', 'X County excluding ...'). This is itself a standard LAUS series, so a balance-of-county unit keeps non_standard_geography = false. Default false; null only when the unit text is too illegible to classify.

unemployment_rate.description: This area's OWN unemployment rate as printed for it (percent, e.g. 8.3 not 0.083). Populate whenever the document prints a per-area rate, including inside a joint_aggregate group — the set's combined rate belongs in local_unemployment.rate_cited, the area's own rate belongs here. Having both is what lets the threshold arithmetic be re-checked downstream. null if no rate is printed for this specific area.

qualifying_basis.description: How THIS area qualifies, within its group. own_rate = its own printed rate meets the cited threshold. own_designation = it holds the designation itself (LSA). carried_by_group = it does not meet the threshold alone and rides on the set's combined numbers (only valid inside a joint_aggregate group). statewide = covered by a whole-state qualification. unknown = not determinable. This preserves, at unit level, which members the bundle was actually built to carry.

group_action.description: FNS action for this group. Use 'denied'/'rejected' as printed; both map to a not-approved outcome downstream. 'withdrawn_by_state' = the area was not decided on the merits because the STATE dropped it from the request (typically declaring it will cover the area with 7 CFR 273.24(g) discretionary exemptions instead); see state_alternative_coverage.

state_alternative_coverage.description: Coverage route the STATE declares it will use instead of a waiver for this group. 'discretionary_exemption_273_24_g' = the state's own rationed 15%/12% ABAWD-month exemption allotment under 7 CFR 273.24(g) — an individual-level state expenditure, NOT an FNS grant and NOT a qualifying criterion. null when the document declares no alternative.

group_action_reason_citation.description: Terse primary statute/regulation/authority cited as the reason for this group's action (typically Waiver Response field 8). Most salient/first if several. null if not explicit.

criteria_summary_text.description: Brief rationale for this group, e.g. 'UER 20 percent above national average, Jan 2001-Dec 2002' or 'designated Labor Surplus Area'.

criterion_verbatim.description: The exact rule phrase/label the DOCUMENT uses (e.g. 'labor surplus area', '20 percent above the national average', 'extended unemployment benefits', 'ARRA suspension'). Verbatim, before normalization.

criterion_code.description: Canonical criterion code from the rules KB (0_lit/00_abawd_rules/002_rules_machine.yaml). Classify which qualifying rule the document INVOKES for this group; do not re-derive whether the area truly qualified. pct10_statutory = area rate >10%. pct20_above_natl = 24-mo area rate >=20% above national ('20% Rule'). lsa = DOL-designated Labor Surplus Area. eb_trigger = Extended Benefits / EUC / EUB trigger. federal_suspension = nationwide suspension (ARRA 2009-10, FFCRA 2020-23). noncontig_1p5x = AK/HI statewide >=1.5x national (OBBB 2025+). other = softer insufficient-jobs evidence (low EPOP, declining industry, study). null if indeterminate.

criterion_other_explanation.description: Required only when criterion_code = 'other', else null.

soft_criterion_invoked.description: true if the applicant or FNS invokes a 'softer' insufficient-jobs rationale with no numeric threshold — 'lack of jobs due to lagging job growth', 'lack of jobs in declining occupations or industries', a declining employment-to-population ratio, or a cited study/publication — REGARDLESS of whether a hard criterion (20% rule, LSA, EB) is also present. INDEPENDENT of criterion_code (which stays whatever hard rule was used, or 'other' if the soft rationale is the sole basis). false if only threshold/designation criteria appear; null if the rationale text is absent/illegible.

soft_criterion_verbatim.description: The exact soft-language phrase(s) used. null unless soft_criterion_invoked = true.

non_bls_source.description: Unemployment/jobs figures from a source other than BLS (state labor agency, Census, an academic study).

seasonally_adjusted.description: Uses seasonally-adjusted figures (the 2006 guidance requires non-seasonally-adjusted).

nonstandard_averaging.description: Averaging / window / rounding other than the standardized 24-month non-seasonally-adjusted procedure (e.g. 3-month, custom windows, unusual rounding).

older_vintage.description: Explicitly relies on an older BLS data vintage than the current release.

note.description: Brief verbatim support for any flag set.

data_nonconformance.description: Departures from the conforming BLS/LAUS, non-seasonally-adjusted, standardized-averaging norm that the DOCUMENT reveals (FNS often names the departure when rejecting). Set a flag true only on affirmative evidence, false when the conforming practice is shown; leave the whole object null when the document gives no data-methodology detail for this group.

value.description: National unemployment rate cited, as a percent number (e.g. 5.8).

text.description: Verbatim phrase if not cleanly numeric.

national_unemployment_rate_cited.description: null when not cited for this group.

rate_cited.description: Local/area unemployment rate cited, percent number.

local_unemployment.description: null when no local rate/window is cited for this group.

waiver_duration_text.description: Duration text if stated, e.g. '1 year'.

applied_waiver_start_date.description: State-requested start if separately stated. YYYY-MM-DD or null.

applied_waiver_end_date.description: State-requested end if separately stated. YYYY-MM-DD or null.

qualification_level.description: The level at which qualification was actually EVALUATED for this group's areas — not how the document phrased them. Answer the counterfactual: if an area were listed alone, would it still qualify under the cited rule? per_unit = yes for every area (the group therefore holds ONE area; six LSA counties = six groups). joint_aggregate = at least one member would fail alone and is carried by the set's combined numbers; the group holds EVERY area the state placed in the set, including those that would have qualified alone. statewide = whole-state qualification with no area test (eb_trigger, federal_suspension, noncontig_1p5x). unknown = genuinely undetermined from this document; do not guess. lsa and pct10_statutory are per_unit by the nature of the rule; pct20_above_natl and other require the evidence tests in 2220b.

qualification_level_evidence.description: Why qualification_level was chosen: the verbatim text that decided it, or a one-line statement of the arithmetic performed (of the form "<area>'s printed rate is below the printed threshold yet it is approved, so the set must be carrying it"). When qualification_level is 'unknown', state exactly what could not be determined. Required reading for the adjudicator; never leave blank on a judgment call.

bundle_label.description: The document's own name for a joint_aggregate set — a compass region, an 'N-County Group', a numbered or branded sub-region. null for per_unit, statewide, or unnamed sets.
